steps.en: OCMS collects outstanding individual driver notices at the first demand stage for today's batch
steps.id: OCMS mengumpulkan notice driver individu tahap demand pertama yang belum dibayar untuk batch hari ini

steps.en: OCMS recognises each unique individual driver in the batch
steps.id: OCMS mengenali tiap driver individu yang unik dalam batch
steps.why_en: The same driver with a different due date is treated as a separate recipient.
steps.why_id: Driver yang sama dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda dianggap penerima terpisah.

steps.en: Only individual drivers get the SMS; opted-out people and passports are skipped
steps.id: Hanya driver individu yang dapat SMS; yang opt-out dan paspor dilewati

steps.en: The SMS lists the unpaid notices merged for each recipient
steps.id: SMS memuat daftar notice yang belum dibayar, digabung per penerima

steps.en: The SMS mentions the first letter
steps.why_en: Only the message template, kept outside the code, decides whether the first letter is mentioned.
steps.why_id: Hanya template pesan di luar code yang menentukan apakah surat pertama disebut.

steps.en: OCMS sends the reminder SMS in a batch
steps.id: OCMS mengirim SMS reminder dalam satu batch
steps.why_en: SMS sending and the daily run are switched off in the production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman SMS dan jadwal harian dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.
